scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('target/main', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.browser.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.chmodSync('target/main/ts/cli/main.js', 0o755); fs.cpSync('src/main/resources', 'target/main/resources', { recursive: true })"
scripts.build:test: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('target/verification', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node -e "require('node:fs').cpSync('src/main/resources', 'target/verification/main/resources', { recursive: true })"
scripts.coverage: npm run build:test && c8 --all --src target/main/ts --src target/verification/main/ts --include 'src/main/ts/**' --exclude-after-remap --reporter lcov --reporter text-summary --reports-dir target/coverage node --test 'target/verification/test/ts/*.test.js'
